# .htaccess TEMPORAL de mantenimiento (503) - subir a la raiz mientras se hace el go-live
# php -- BEGIN cPanel-generated handler, do not edit
# Set the "ea-php74" package as the default "PHP" programming language (necesario para /admin headless)
<IfModule mime_module>
  AddHandler application/x-httpd-ea-php74 .php .php7 .phtml
</IfModule>
# php -- END cPanel-generated handler, do not edit

<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
  RewriteEngine On
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !^/admin/
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !^/wp-content/uploads/
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !^/\.well-known/
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !^/mantenimiento\.html$
  RewriteRule ^ - [R=503,L]
</IfModule>
ErrorDocument 503 /mantenimiento.html
<IfModule mod_headers.c>
  Header always set Retry-After "3600"
</IfModule>
